import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { activeStorageAttachments } from "./active_storage_attachments";
import { activeStorageVariantRecords } from "./active_storage_variant_records";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "key" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "filename" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "content_type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "checksum" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "service_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const activeStorageBlobs = defineTable("active_storage_blobs", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        key: col.text().notNull().unique(),
        filename: col.text().notNull(),
        contentType: col.text(),
        metadata: col.text(),
        byteSize: col.bigint().notNull(),
        checksum: col.text(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        serviceName: col.text().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        active_storage_attachments: rel.hasMany(() => activeStorageAttachments, { foreignKey: "blob_id" }),
        active_storage_variant_records: rel.hasMany(() => activeStorageVariantRecords, { foreignKey: "blob_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
